positions.name: AsyncRememberJobContract
positions.frame: how does remember hand control back to the agent while extraction runs, and how does the agent come to see the outcome without blocking or losing work?
positions.why: Both segments describe the same ratified async job contract for remember. src-1 gives the contract: an immediate receipt, extraction watched by polling a cursor, no blocking call, and durable work if the client drops the receipt. src-2 records the decision on how the outcome is seen, either the agent polls the run or the reaction is piggybacked on a later call. They are one reading of how the immediate-return remember behaves. A mild tension is held, not resolved: src-1 names polling as the watching mechanism, while src-2 leaves piggybacking as an alternative to polling.
